summary: HUD penalty-message and ring-buffer event handler. When the penalty-state flag at this+0x30 is clear, it resolves the penalty message text ('Stop Go Penalty' plus driver name) through the message string table, renders it to the HUD text line, records a penalty event (type 4, id 23) with the driver identifier and current session time into the 432-byte-stride ring buffer, and finally dispatches the penalty to the vehicle object. Skipped entirely while the penalty-state flag is set.

local_names.this+0x0: pointer to the vehicle/object receiving the penalty
local_names.this+0x4: driver/vehicle identifier recorded in the event
local_names.dword_8AAE64: ring buffer write pointer, advanced by 432 per event
local_names.dword_83EE60: ring buffer entry counter, capped at 1023
local_names.dbl_8AFEA0: current session time passed to the event encoder
